## Build, watch or play

From this directory, run `./build.sh`, then `./watch.sh`. Use `./watch.sh --verify-only` for a verification without opening the player. Where a starting save is retained, `./play.sh --label "My attempt"` records an alternative human continuation and adds it to this report. ## Evaluation and diagnosis

See the [overall assessment](overall-assessment.md). The CL2 Paladin entered whole-level
flight after seeing two white worm masses. It was then hit five times by a 2-HP grey mold
that it never attacked: caution retreats while adjacent, and the stair flow re-approaches.
It died of worm poison while carrying eight unidentified Cure Light Wounds. These are
source-checked mechanisms with native position evidence. The owner's verified manual branch from 27526 killed the mold in one blow, then the worms, and
survived. No reusable original-C defect or policy benefit is established.
